$description: Jahnoah.lol — personal, art, creative, sensual, uncorporate. Tone: dim room, warm light, no chrome. Dark by default (no light mode needed — this site doesn't perform daytime professionalism). Type does the emotional work since there's no house accent color; color comes from the uploaded media itself.

ink.$description: near-white warm text on the dark surface

paper.$description: near-black with a warm (not blue) cast

ember.$description: the one warm accent — used sparingly: active states, one hover glow

plum.$description: card/surface tint, not a text color

display.$description: italic optical size on headlines — a handwritten, intimate register vs. Jahnoah.com's upright serif

radius.$description: soft, room-like — the opposite of OnlyJah's tight 10px

shadow.$description: the one property on this site that DOES use soft shadow — it's meant to feel like gallery lighting, not a SaaS card

$contentNote: This property is media-led — galleries, long-form posts, audio/video from OJ-Kash. Keep chrome minimal so uploaded work is always the brightest thing on screen. Age/content gating is a product decision to confirm before launch, not a design one.
